Agent & L/C Agent), fronting banks (Barclays, JPMorgan, RBC, SC, Standard Chartered). - **Exculpatory Clauses**: No fiduciary duty; no discretionary power beyond what is expressly granted in Article VII; no liability for acts of the banks except in case of gross negligence or willful misconduct. - **Record-keeping**: Generates a pro-rated register for each bank (loan principal, interest, fees, reimbursement obligations). Entries conclusive absent manifest error. - **Payment Distributor**: Allocates borrower payments to banks per the following priority: (1) Agent's out-of-pocket costs, (2) L/C and swing-line cash collateral, (3) unpaid loans, (4) outstanding fees/instruments, (5) surplus. --- ### 8. Limitation Limits & Safeguards - **Public Debt Rating Table**: Determines commitment/letter-of-credit fee and margin. - **Multiple's "Ten-Non-Bank Rule"**: Limits non-qualifying banks to 10 total in the agreement; satisfies Swiss withholding-tax compliance. - **Credit Exposure Cap**: The borrower may never have credit exposure > 105 % of aggregate commitments when foreign-currency L/Cs have > 2 BD imbalance; otherwise no default trigger. --- ### 10.
